# API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-api-docs.mjs from the code. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:api`. -->

Base URL: `/api/v1` (the health check is `/health`). 203 endpoints.
Interactive documentation: `/api/docs` (Swagger UI, not in production unless `SWAGGER_ENABLED=true`).
Machine-readable: [`docs/api/openapi.json`](api/openapi.json); Postman: [`docs/api/ROF-LMS.postman_collection.json`](api/ROF-LMS.postman_collection.json).

**Conventions.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`).
Lists return `{ data, meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }` with `?page=&limit=` (max 100).
Errors return `{ statusCode, error, code, message, details?, requestId }`; branch on `code`.
Unknown body or query fields are rejected (`VALIDATION_FAILED`).

## Academic years

### GET `/api/v1/academic-years`

**Access:** STUDENT, MENTOR, ADMIN

## Admin · Academic years

### POST `/api/v1/admin/academic-years`

**Access:** ADMIN

Plan a new academic year (status PLANNED).

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `name` | string | ✓ | e.g. "2027-2028". |
| `startsOn` | string | ✓ | First day (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `endsOn` | string | ✓ | Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). |

### GET `/api/v1/admin/academic-years/{id}`

**Access:** ADMIN

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

### PATCH `/api/v1/admin/academic-years/{id}`

**Access:** ADMIN

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `startsOn` | string |  |  |
| `endsOn` | string |  |  |

### POST `/api/v1/admin/academic-years/{id}/activate`

**Access:** ADMIN

Start the year: closes the current one (archiving its assignments) and
rolls every active student over — promoted one grade when requested.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `promoteStudents` | boolean | ✓ | Move every active student up one grade (true at the start of a new school year). |
| `deactivateGraduates` | boolean |  | When promoting, deactivate S6 students who graduate (default true). |

### GET `/api/v1/admin/academic-years/{id}/enrollments`

**Access:** ADMIN

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `divisionId` | query | string |  |  |
| `gradeLevel` | query | S1 \| S2 \| S3 \| S4 \| S5 \| S6 |  |  |
| `status` | query | ACTIVE \| PROMOTED \| GRADUATED \| WITHDRAWN |  |  |
| `schoolId` | query | string |  |  |

### PATCH `/api/v1/admin/enrollments/{id}`

**Access:** ADMIN

Correct a grade or withdraw a student (current year only).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `gradeLevel` | S1 \| S2 \| S3 \| S4 \| S5 \| S6 |  | Correct the student's grade in the current year (moves division if needed). |
| `status` | WITHDRAWN |  | WITHDRAWN ends the enrolment and suspends the account. |

### GET `/api/v1/admin/email/jobs`

**Access:** ADMIN

### GET `/api/v1/admin/email/jobs/{id}`

|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

### GET `/api/v1/admin/email/jobs/{id}/deliveries`

**Access:** ADMIN

Per-recipient delivery status (filter with ?status=FAILED).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

### POST `/api/v1/admin/email/jobs/{id}/retry`

**Access:** ADMIN

Re-queue FAILED deliveries. SENT deliveries are never re-sent.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

### POST `/api/v1/admin/email/send`

**Access:** ADMIN

Queue a bulk e-mail. Returns the job immediately; sending happens in the
background. Re-using an idempotencyKey returns the original job
(`alreadyExisted: true`) instead of sending again.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `idempotencyKey` | string | ✓ | Idempotency key supplied by the caller. Re-submitting the same key returns the existing job rather than dispatching duplicate messages. Use a UUID or a stable hash. |
| `recipientMode` | EXPLICIT \| ROLE \| DIVISION \| SCHOOL \| ALL | ✓ |  |
| `recipientUserIds` | string[] |  | Required when recipientMode is EXPLICIT. Maximum 500 recipients per request. |
| `recipientRole` | string |  | Required when recipientMode is ROLE. Valid values: STUDENT | MENTOR | ADMIN |
| `recipientDivisionId` | string (uuid) |  | Required when recipientMode is DIVISION. |
| `recipientSchoolId` | string (uuid) |  | Required when recipientMode is SCHOOL. |
| `subject` | string | ✓ |  |
| `body` | string | ✓ | Plain-text message body. HTML is intentionally not supported to reduce XSS risk and simplify the implementation. Add HTML support here when needed. |

### GET `/api/v1/admin/email/users`

**Access:** ADMIN

Paginated, filterable user list with email addresses.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `role` | query | string |  | Filter by global role. |
| `schoolId` | query | string |  | Filter to students enrolled at this school (by school ID). |
| `divisionId` | query | string |  | Filter to students of a division. |
| `search` | query | string |  | Free-text search across firstName, lastName, username, and email. |
| `isApproved` | query | boolean |  | Filter by isApproved status. |
| `page` | query | number |  | Page number (1-based). |
| `limit` | query | number |  | Page size (default: 50, max enforced in service). |

## Admin · Settings

### GET `/api/v1/admin/settings`

**Access:** ADMIN

All settings by category (registration, assignments, notification rules,
live sessions, platform, support) with current value, default, type,
limits and who changed it last. Academic years are managed under
/admin/academic-years.

### PATCH `/api/v1/admin/settings`

**Access:** ADMIN

Change one or more settings: `{ "notifications.deadlineReminderHours": 48 }`. Every change is audited.

### POST `/api/v1/admin/users/import`

**Access:** ADMIN

Bulk-invite from a CSV file (field "file", UTF-8, max 1 MB / 1000 rows).
Header: firstName,lastName,email[,role,gradeLevel,schoolName,schoolLocation,homeLocation,username].
Valid rows are invited; invalid rows are reported. ?dryRun=true validates only.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `dryRun` | query | boolean |  | Validate only; create nothing. |

### POST `/api/v1/admin/users/invite`

**Access:** ADMIN

Invite a person: the account is created without a password and an
activation link (valid 7 days) is e-mailed. Students need a gradeLevel.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `firstName` | string | ✓ |  |
